explanation: The natural language specifies that when the sensor limits are exceeded, and the pilot is not in control (standby), with system support without failures (supported && !apfail), then an autopilot pullup should occur. The structured NL property captures this condition by asserting the pullup occurs whenever these combined conditions satisfy.
decision3: at the next timepoint satisfy bool_exp3
decision2_substring: Exceeding sensor limits shall latch an autopilot pullup when the pilot is not in control (not standby) and the system is supported without failures (not apfail).
output_structured_natural_language: whenever (limits) & (!standby) & (supported) & (!apfail), at the next timepoint satisfy pullup
